messages.content:
After a quiet minute, clients get their whole burst back, even when their limit says
the bucket should take much longer to refill. billing-export has a burst of 5 and 2
requests per minute. Yesterday it used up its burst at 14:00:00, sent nothing until
14:01:10, and then got 5 requests through at once; at 2 per minute it should have had
2. examples/gateway-2026-10-28.csv is that part of the gateway log, and throttle
replay shows 10 allowed requests for billing-export where there should be 7.

Please fix the limiter so that a client never gets back more tokens than its bucket
refills while it is idle (and never more than its burst). It should still forget idle
clients, so that its memory stays bounded.

Two more things while you are at it:

- Rejected requests sometimes come back with retry_after_s of 0, so clients retry at
  once and are rejected again. retry_after_s should be the number of seconds until the
  request would be allowed, rounded up to a whole second.
- The partner integrations team published the limits they agreed with our partners in
  data/partner-limits.toml. throttle limits and throttle replay with our configuration
  should apply them to the partner clients.

Clients that are not idle that long should get exactly the decisions they get today,
and the output of throttle replay and throttle limits should keep its layout.
